The Lantern

Mira opened the brass lantern. A small blue light filled the room.

“Can you hear me?” she asked. The answer arrived with a chime: “Yes, Mira.”

A compass 🧭 pointed north; café bells sounded beyond the window.

At dawn, Mira crossed the bridge. Below her, the river carried leaves toward the sea.

“We have time,” said Rowan. “Then let us walk,” Mira replied.

The lantern dimmed, but its light never disappeared.
